scenario: Task contract exists with acceptance criteria and testing mandate. No feedback.yaml present (Build Mode).
setup: Create .workflow/current_task.yaml with a simple task (add a utility function). Provide context_to_load files.
expected_behavior: Writes failing tests BEFORE any implementation code
Red phase output shows real test failure messages
Implementation is minimal — passes tests without gold-plating
review_ready.yaml includes tdd_evidence with red phase details
Only files in files_to_touch are modified

scenario: Both current_task.yaml and feedback.yaml exist (Fix Mode). Feedback contains a test_quality rejection.
setup: Create .workflow/current_task.yaml and .workflow/feedback.yaml with specific test_quality failure on a named file.
expected_behavior: Detects Fix Mode from feedback.yaml presence
Reads feedback before making any changes
Fixes only the specific issue cited in feedback
Preserves passing tests from previous attempt

scenario: Task contract requires changes that would violate component boundaries in COMPONENTS.yaml.
setup: Create a task that needs to import from a component forbidden by dependency_rules. Provide COMPONENTS.yaml with the rule.
expected_behavior: Detects the dependency violation before or during implementation
Writes to design_issues.yaml instead of forcing the violation
HALTs the task — does not attempt a workaround
